tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bsngo ba'i yon bshad dang bsngo ba mdor bsdus bkod pa legs byas kyi shing rta bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// dpal kun 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma la// mchog gsum ngo bor mchog tu gus pas 'dud// yon sbyor byed po yon bdag spro bskyed phyir// byang chub bsngo smon byang chub yon bshad bri// zhes bya ba'i tshig gi brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ 'dir bsngo ba'i yon bshad dang bsngo ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus mtshon dper 'god pa la/ de yang bsngo ba'i yon bshad rgyas pa ni kun mkhyen chen po ngag dbang nor bu dang*/ mkhas mchog buddha badzra/ rje bod mkhas pa chen po sogs kyis mdzad snang bas der shes la/ bar ma 'bring por brjod pa bgyid na/ de yang 'dir yon gyi bdag pos lhag bsam rmad du byung bas dge legs kyi phung po sbyin pa rgya cher spel ba 'di ni 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur ba yin te/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pas yi dwags 'gro ba gcod// dbul ba dang ni de bzhin nyon mongs thams cad gcod// spyod tshe longs spyod mtha' yas rgyas pa thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mdo gzhan las kyang*// sbyin pas 'byung po dbang du byed// sbyin pas pha rol gnyen du 'gyur// sbyin pas 'khon rnams nyams par 'gyur// de phyir sbyin pa gtso bor byed// zhes dang*// rgyal ba'i skyes rabs las/ sbyin pa nor gyi snying po len par gsungs// sbyin pa dbang phyug rnams kyi rgyu zhes gsungs// sbyin pa dpal ldan skyes bu mchog gi tshul// shes rab chung ngus rdul tsam sbyin mi nus// ces gsungs shing*/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyis kyang*/ bshes spring du/ longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas// dge sbyong bram ze bkren dang bshes rnams la// sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal bgyi pha rol na// sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so// zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sbyin pa'i phan yon ni mtshon tsam gsungs pa yin/

sbyin pa la dbye na gsum du 'gyur te/ gdul bya'i skal pa dang rjes su mthun par legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ longs spyod la chags pa med par gang la ci 'dod pa'i phan 'dogs pa zang zing gi sbyin pa dang*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las 'phral yun du bsrung ba mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa gsum du 'du ba yin te/ mdo las/ chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs gsum du rnam phye nas// pha rol phyin pa 'di dag sbyin pa'i ngo bo nyid// ces gsungs/ de ltar sbyin pa'i rtsa ba rnams kyang*/ yongs su bsngo ba chen pos rgyas btab dgos te/ lung las/ bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni// sems can kun la yongs bsngo ba// thub pa khyod kyis gang gsungs pa// de gzhan bstan bcos las ma bshad// ces dge ba byas shing bsags pa thams cad gzhan don du bsngo ba spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa thams cad dang*/ bye brag theg chen po'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin la/ bsngo bas ma zin na/ dge rtsa 'dzad pa'i rgyu/ yul khyad par can la khong khro drag po skyes pa dang*/ log par lta ba dang*/ dge ba la 'gyod pa skyes pa dang*/ skur 'debs byas pa sogs tshul min log rtog ngan pas dge ba la bar du gcod par gsungs pas/ spyod 'jug tu/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi// sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs// legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang*// khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed// ces pa lta bus mtshon bag yod par bya dgos/ byang chub tu bsngos pa'i dge ba ni nam yang mi 'dzad cing 'phel bar 'gyur te/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung*// rgya mtsho ma skam bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang*// byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad// ces dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu phyung nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// ces gsungs/

der ma zad dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur nges par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod de/ sdud pa las/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid phyir yongs su bsngos byas na// byang chub ces byar drug po 'di kun ro gcig 'gyur// ces gsungs pa bzhin/ de ltar na yongs su bsngo ba'i tshul ni/ phal po che'i mdo las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po spyod phyir de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig /zhes pa ltar/ bdag gzhan 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad/ gzhan don sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i phyir du bsngo ba yin la/ de yang skyabs yul dpang por gsol te bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya ste/ mdo las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun du thub pa bzhugs// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum spyan// dus la'ang ye shes sgrib pa med// ces pa ltar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams chags thogs med pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa mnga' ba'i phyir/ 'o skol gyi sgo gsum byed spyod thams cad gzigs mod kyang*/ rang gi mos yul du'ang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa bzhin du bzhugs pas bsngo smon la thugs gtad par bsam pa dang*/ rang cag gi bsngo smon gyi 'dun pa yang sangs rgyas la mkhyen par gsol nas/ rgyu 'di las 'bras bu rnam par dag pa 'di lta bu thob par gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ spyir yang rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po don du gnyer ba'i blo 'dun dad pa 'gog pa med par bskyed pa sogs bsngo ba smon lam gyi gnad la mkhas par bya dgos pas/ de ltar thugs yul du bzhugs nas dge 'dun rnams kyis bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur mdzad pa zhu/

zhes brjod nas gson bsngo bgyid na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar sbyin pa pos dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi mthu dang nus pa la bsten nas/ rgyal ba thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan pa'i gnyen gyur dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchog tu gyur pa gang na su bzhugs thams cad kyang sku tshe brtan cing*/ rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad 'phrin thams cad yar zla ltar 'phel bar gyur cig tshogs na spyod pa dang dben pa'i rir bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dang*/ rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa po pho mo la sogs pa thams cad kyang bslab pa gsum dang*/ nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing*/ sa lam gyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig bla ma mchog gsum skyabs yul gong ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin gyis rlabs pa la bsten nas/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la tshe 'dir bar du gcod pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i tshogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig bye brag tu yang las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i nad gdon bgegs kyis 'tshe ba/ pha rol gyi rigs sngags las gyur pa'i gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi gnod pa dang*/ lo nyes pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa dang*/ byur dang*/ skal pa ngan pa dang*/ dgra'i gnod pa dang*/ 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang dbang phyug dpal dang grags pa/ 'khor dang longs spyod/ bsod nams dang ye shes la sogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig

mdor na rgyu'i dus su tshogs gnyis rlabs po che yongs su bsog par nus pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig lam gyi dus su sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong bar nus pa'i skal ba dang ldan gyur cig 'bras bu'i dus su dag pa gnyis ldan gyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig khyad par du yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i skal bar ldan cing lam rim pa gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs te myur du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// sogs dang*/ bsod nams stobs chen/ lo brgya 'tsho zhing sogs bsngo smon tshig bcad gang 'os bya'o// gson bsngo de las bsdus par bya na dgongs gsol sngar bzhin la/ 'di ltar sbyin pa pos sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon byed du byas nas/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi mthu las/ lung rtogs gnyis ldan gyi bstan pa de 'dzin dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig chos ldan gyi sgrub pa po'am sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di nyid kyang nad gdon bgegs kyis 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes sogs gong 'phel du gyur pas dam pa'i chos kyi dpal la mnga' 'byor bar gyur cig myur du tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis dag ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du yang phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing chos ldan gyi bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par gyur cig sbyin pa gtong zhing= 'bad dang rtsol ba sogs dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o// yang gshin bsngo lta bur/ phyogs cur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyi gzugs rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba'i thog drangs sems can thams cad la dgongs su gsol/

dmigs yul des tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du bsags pa'i dus gsum gyi legs spyad ci mchis pa dang*/ shul du gnas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ dkon mchog mchod cing*/ ngan slong la sbyin pa btang ba/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ gzung sngags bzlas pa sogs dge ba byas bsags thams cad kyi mthu nus la bsten nas/ dus 'das de dag 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skye 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa yongs su byang bar gyur cig bar do'i 'jigs skrag las yongs su grol te dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po dang*/ 'jam pa'i dpal dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po rnams kyi zhal mjal ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar te nub phyogs bde ba can dang*/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba/ dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang*/ padma 'od sogs zhing khams rnam par dag pa rnams su skye ba len par nus pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig skyes ma thag tu'ang bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang*/ bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ rgyal ba byams pa/ rig 'dzin slob dpon chen po padma kā ra sogs kyi zhal mjal zhing rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig der nam byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang spyod yul gcig pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bcu la sogs pa'i lam la slob cing lam gyi mngon rtogs mthar phyin par gyur cig zhing nas zhing nyul te sngags spyod kyi zhing du sngags lam bde ba chen po'i ye shes mthar phyin pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig gal te las nyon gyi 'ching pas srid par skye ba len par gyur na dal 'byor chos ldan gyi lus rten bzang po thob par gyur cig ma nor dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes su bzung nas theg pa chen po'i chos la spyod pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig dam sdom rnam par gtsang zhing smin grol sa lam gyi yon tan gong du 'phel te/

mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ngan song sdug bsngal mi myong zhing sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing sogs bsngo smon bya'o// gshin bsngo de las bsdus pa bya na/ dgongs gsol sngar bzhin nas/ tshe 'das de nyid kyis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba dang*/ shul na gnas pa rnams kyis 'di ltar sgrubs pa'i dge ba'i mthu las/ dmigs yul de nyid srid pa bar do'i sdug bsngal las grol bar gyur cig bar do la bar dor ngo shes pas 'khrul pa'i snang ba dbyings su dag nas bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag par skye ba len nus par gyur cig skyes ma thag tu rgyal sras rab 'byams kyi zhal mjal te dam pa'i chos kyi sgo mtha' yas par spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig mdor na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las grol te sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig bde ba can gyi zhing khams na sogs smon lam skabs bstun bya'o// de tsam dper mtshon te/ gzhan ni tshig don bzang po'i rang bzhin mkhyen klong nas dpyad pa'i babs 'os dang*/ rgyas bsdus skabs bstun mdzad pa legs so// theg chen chos la spyod pa'i lugs// bsngo ba smon lam rim pa yis// 'brel thogs 'gro la phan 'dogs phyir// bkod gang don ldan nyid gyur cig /ces bsngo ba'i yon bshad dang*/ bsngo ba rgyas bsdus kyi rim pa dper brjod du bkod pa 'di bzhin/ bde chen chos 'khor nas yongs 'dzin mchog sprul rin po che'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar/ 7 mi pham chos kyi snang bas g.yeng ba'i bar gseng zhig la bris pa lags/// /
